parameters.query:
-- Every Monday at 6.15. The computer n8n runs on may be asleep then, so
-- the trigger fires every hour, and this lets a run through only when the
-- latest Monday 6.15 has passed since the archive was last read
-- (newsletter_archive_read_at, which the dashboard's "Tuo uudet nyt" sets
-- too), and only once an admin has given the archive's address. Otherwise
-- nothing comes out and the run ends here. A read that fails is tried again
-- the next hour.
WITH here AS (
    SELECT now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Helsinki' AS now
),
slot AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN planned <= now THEN planned ELSE planned - interval '7 days' END AS at
      FROM (SELECT now, date_trunc('week', now) + time '06:15' AS planned FROM here) x
),
last_run AS (
    SELECT (SELECT nullif(value, '')::timestamptz FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'newsletter_archive_read_at') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Helsinki' AS at
)
SELECT to_char(slot.at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS due_since
  FROM slot, last_run
 WHERE coalesce(last_run.at, '-infinity') < slot.at
   AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'newsletter_archive_url' AND value <> '');

nodes.name: Bring in new newsletters
nodes.notes: The association's newsletters sent since last week, from its public archive in Mailchimp, so the dashboard can compare each with what the system found (Uutiskirjeet → Arkisto). The dashboard reads the archive; this only asks it to. Until an admin gives the archive's address there is nothing to do. dashboard/app/services/archive.py, db/init/32-archive-import.sql.
